name: FIPS 140-3 approved algorithms
edition: FIPS 140-3 Annex A, with SP 800-56A Rev. 3, FIPS 186-5 and SP 800-38D
reference: FIPS 140-3 Annex A (approved security functions); SP 800-56A Rev. 3 Appendix D (approved ECC curves: Table 24; approved FFC safe-prime groups: Table 26); FIPS 186-5 §1 (approved signatures RSA/ECDSA/EdDSA; DSA no longer approved for generation); SP 800-38D (GCM is an approved AEAD mode of AES).
summary: Only FIPS-approved security functions. AES in any approved mode; NIST curves and RFC 7919 safe-prime groups; RSA/ECDSA/EdDSA signatures. Notably excludes ChaCha20-Poly1305, which has no NIST approval.
notes: cipher_suites.allow is every AES suite (SP 800-38D approves AES-GCM; AES-CBC and AES-CCM are approved AES modes; HMAC-SHA-1 is approved for MAC use) with an authenticated key establishment, i.e. every AES suite the scanner knows except the anonymous ones. ChaCha20-Poly1305 has no FIPS approval and is therefore excluded -- which a shape-tag allowlist could not express, since AES and ChaCha20 share the 'aead' tag. groups.allow: SP 800-56A Rev. 3 Table 24 approves the NIST curves (P-224/256/384/521 = secp224r1/secp256r1/secp384r1/secp521r1) and Table 26 approves the RFC 7919 safe-prime groups (ffdhe2048-8192); the RFC 7748 curves x25519/x448 are NOT in SP 800-56A and are excluded. signature_algorithms.allow: FIPS 186-5 §1 approves RSA, ECDSA and EdDSA (Ed25519/Ed448); DSA 'is no longer ... approved ... for digital signature generation' and SHA-1/MD5 signatures are not approved. certificate min_rsa_bits 2048, min_ec_bits 224 (112-bit floor). FLAG: FIPS 140-3 is about a validated cryptographic MODULE, not only algorithm names -- treat a pass here as necessary, not sufficient, and confirm against the module's CMVP security policy. Validated modules vary and some omit EdDSA.
